name: Azeroth Companion
title: Desktop Hyper Stack & Site Welcome Soundtrack
features: Moved HYPER MUSIC to the right-hand desktop column directly above the Founder avatar, preserving the existing mobile top-header positions.
Added an optional site-hosted welcome soundtrack powered by the existing music player; desktop will attempt autoplay when browser policy allows and otherwise offer a manual Play action.
Mobile offers a one-tap Play Welcome Theme control in the main website header when the audio file has been uploaded.
A configured audio asset path and owner upload instructions are ready; the soundtrack is not active until the owner adds the licensed MP3 to assets/nexus-intro.mp3.
Private playlists, audio controls, Talent Forge, saved builds, API integrations and existing release automation are preserved.
